proposed_from.topic: is adaptation to an unknown carryover-decay scale free in switchback experimental design: in the design-based regime with one unit, horizon T, binary assignment path W in {0,1}^T and a FIXED potential-outcome array Y_t : {0,1}^t -> [-B,B] (all randomness in the assignment, no outcome noise), restrict carryover NOT by a distributed-lag functional form but by an impulse-response envelope on the potential-outcome map itself, Yc(w) := { Y : |Y_t(z_{1:t}) - Y_t(z'_{1:t})| <= sum_{l<t} w_l 1{z_{t-l} != z'_{t-l}}; |Y_t| <= B }, and take the nested scale Pc_beta := Yc(w^{(beta)}) with w^{(beta)}_l = C(1+l)^{-(1+beta)} for beta in [beta_lo,beta_hi], so beta' > beta implies Pc_{beta'} subset Pc_beta; for the design-identified GATE_T(Y) = (1/T) sum_t [Y_t(1_{1:t}) - Y_t(0_{1:t})], let D_T be ALL randomized assignment rules L(W_t | W_{1:t-1}, Y^obs_{1:t-1}) (fully sequential rules included, non-adaptive designs a subclass), define the oracle minimax risk R_T(beta) := inf over pi in D_T, inf over theta_hat, sup over Y in Pc_beta of E_pi|theta_hat - GATE_T(Y)| and the ADAPTATION INDEX A_T := inf over pi in D_T, inf over theta_hat, sup over beta in [beta_lo,beta_hi] of (sup over Y in Pc_beta of E_pi|theta_hat - GATE_T(Y)|)/R_T(beta), and settle the dichotomy (K1) A_T -> infinity, so no design — including sequential ones that re-target using realized past outcomes — matches the beta-aware oracle simultaneously up to a T-free constant, adaptation is never free; and (K2) A_T = T^{o(1)}, so knowledge of beta is worth no power of T. The exact orders of A_T and R_T(beta), the optimal block geometry in beta, the multiscale design and selection rule attaining (K2), the two-class construction attaining (K1), and all constants are DELEGATED. This is the min-over-designs-max-over-the-PAIR (array, decay index) problem that Bojinov-Simchi-Levi-Zhao Thm 2 and Yu-Ma-Liu Thm 2 never pose, both holding the carryover order KNOWN

seed_list: A single multiscale switchback can match every beta-aware polynomial-tail oracle up to a logarithmic factor, despite allowing sequential outcome-adaptive competitors.
Two polynomial decay classes force a diverging adaptation index over fixed potential-outcome arrays, so learning decay is information-theoretically costly.
Outcome-adaptive sequential randomization has no minimax rate advantage over nonadaptive switchbacks under a pathwise carryover envelope.
Known polynomial carryover has the minimax absolute-risk rate \(T^{-\beta/(2\beta+1)}\) and a rate-optimal block geometry.
Honest randomization intervals over polynomial-tail classes obey a beta-specific expected-length adaptation frontier.
A decay exponent becomes testable from one randomized path only after a sharp self-similarity separation of nested envelope classes.
A rank-deficient realized switchback history yields a sharp envelope-induced identified diameter for sustained-regime effects.
Polynomial forgetting changes the burn-in bias--variance frontier relative to geometric-mixing switchbacks without invoking a stochastic state model.

seed_details.one_line: A single multiscale switchback can match every beta-aware polynomial-tail oracle up to a logarithmic factor, despite allowing sequential outcome-adaptive competitors.

anchor_paper.author: Bojinov et al.
anchor_paper.claim: The minimax cadence is optimized after assuming perfect knowledge of finite order \(m\), and order learning uses two separated experimental units.
anchor_paper.verbatim_quote: Throughout this section we assume perfect knowledge of \(m\) and assume \(p=m\).

seed_details.anti_pattern_check: M13 plus M11, not a routine finite-order extension: the focal object is the ratio to every beta-specific oracle over one common design.
seed_details.referee_objection: Immediate from Goldenshluger--Lepski because beta is just a bandwidth.
seed_details.rebuttal: The selector must be embedded in a single assignment path and compared with an oracle that optimizes the randomization itself, including sequential policies.
seed_details.strict_delta: The theorem covers a nested infinite-tail family and one common design rather than a design conditional on known order.
seed_details.routine_collapse_check: field-tier: the construction must still establish design-specific concentration and a sequential-policy lower bound.

adversarial_referee.instance: The design is merely estimator tuning.
adversarial_referee.rebuttal_or_downgrade: The design allocates randomized time across scales and is the decision variable.
The cited protocol requires separate units and has no uniform oracle ratio.

adversarial_referee.instance: The array and beta are not jointly optimized.
adversarial_referee.rebuttal_or_downgrade: Both enter the displayed supremum defining \(A_T\).

seed_details.one_line: Two polynomial decay classes force a diverging adaptation index over fixed potential-outcome arrays, so learning decay is information-theoretically costly.

anchor_paper.author: Duchi and Ruan
anchor_paper.claim: A constrained-risk inequality delivers adaptive lower bounds under general loss.

seed_details.anti_pattern_check: M11 plus M7: the lower bound must be uniform over policy-dependent assignment laws, not a hand-picked pair.
seed_details.referee_objection: Nested classes always make exact adaptation impossible by Brown--Low.
seed_details.rebuttal: The experiment law is assignment-generated and risk is allowed to optimize a design, so a policy-uniform indistinguishability construction is new.

adversarial_referee.instance: The two arrays can be distinguished after feedback.
adversarial_referee.rebuttal_or_downgrade: A valid proof would require identical observed-history laws under every policy.
The missing part is policy-dependent experiment-law control.

adversarial_referee.instance: A lower bound only treats one design.
adversarial_referee.rebuttal_or_downgrade: The seed explicitly quantifies over \(\mathcal D_T\).

seed_details.one_line: Outcome-adaptive sequential randomization has no minimax rate advantage over nonadaptive switchbacks under a pathwise carryover envelope.

anchor_paper.author: Glynn et al.
anchor_paper.claim: Adaptive online design is efficient under unknown Markov-chain transition dynamics.

seed_details.anti_pattern_check: M13: it compares design classes rather than adding a sequential algorithm.
seed_details.referee_objection: False because adaptive designs help in Markov systems.
seed_details.rebuttal: The proposed adversarial fixed-array regime deliberately removes reusable transition primitives that make their MDP reduction possible.

adversarial_referee.instance: No-gain follows only at a constant array.
adversarial_referee.rebuttal_or_downgrade: Require a full polynomial-envelope lower-bound family.
It is model-based maximum-likelihood design and is used only as a contrast.
That theory does not cover infinite polynomial carryover.

seed_details.one_line: Known polynomial carryover has the minimax absolute-risk rate \(T^{-\beta/(2\beta+1)}\) and a rate-optimal block geometry.

anchor_paper.author: Hu and Wager
anchor_paper.claim: Geometric mixing converts a burn-in choice into nearly parametric global-effect error.

seed_details.anti_pattern_check: M13 plus M11, with the rate as a function of the named tail index.
seed_details.referee_objection: Just replace exponential decay by a polynomial tail.
seed_details.rebuttal: A deterministic envelope permits arbitrary nonstationarity and needs an all-design lower bound, unlike a Markov mixing calculation.

adversarial_referee.instance: Only an upper bound is supplied.
adversarial_referee.rebuttal_or_downgrade: The seed requires matching minimax bounds.
The cutoff must be optimized against cumulative tail bias.

adversarial_referee.instance: It is only an estimator result.
adversarial_referee.rebuttal_or_downgrade: The cadence is chosen by the minimax criterion.

seed_details.one_line: Honest randomization intervals over polynomial-tail classes obey a beta-specific expected-length adaptation frontier.

anchor_paper.author: Liu and Zhong
anchor_paper.claim: Conditional randomization tests impose a known finite carryover horizon to ensure imputability.

seed_details.anti_pattern_check: M17 plus M3: the focal object is expected length under uniform coverage, not a generic test.
seed_details.referee_objection: Cai--Low already resolves nested-class interval adaptation.
seed_details.rebuttal: The modulus must be built from assignment-induced laws for nonimputable infinite-memory outcomes.

adversarial_referee.rebuttal_or_downgrade: Tail budgeting replaces exact finite-window imputability.

adversarial_referee.instance: Coverage has no matching length lower bound.
adversarial_referee.rebuttal_or_downgrade: The seed requires a between-class modulus converse.
Their procedure conditions on a known horizon.

seed_details.one_line: A decay exponent becomes testable from one randomized path only after a sharp self-similarity separation of nested envelope classes.

anchor_paper.author: Missault and Masoero
anchor_paper.claim: Comparing estimators at different finite lags detects an underestimated influence period.

seed_details.anti_pattern_check: M11 plus M7: it names a separation rate rather than treating nested labels as identified parameters.
seed_details.referee_objection: Beta is not identified because the classes are nested.
seed_details.rebuttal: The seed asks for the minimal self-similarity separation that makes testing possible and proves impossibility without it.

adversarial_referee.instance: Self-similarity is asserted solely for testing.
adversarial_referee.rebuttal_or_downgrade: It must be tied to a concrete persistent-tail mechanism.
The result must be uniform over separated subclasses.
They test under-specified windows, not a nested exponent.

seed_details.one_line: A rank-deficient realized switchback history yields a sharp envelope-induced identified diameter for sustained-regime effects.

anchor_paper.author: CausalSmith prior proposal
anchor_paper.claim: The rejected proposal identified unknown-order misspecification and inference under rank-deficient histories as the remaining frontier.
anchor_paper.verbatim_quote: unknown-L misspecification, testable influence-period certificates, or estimator validity under rank-deficient histories

seed_details.anti_pattern_check: M10: the object is a sharp pathwise modulus rather than a row-span tautology.
seed_details.referee_objection: This is the failed de Bruijn rank audit under new words.
seed_details.rebuttal: The envelope couples unobserved histories and calls for an identified diameter plus coverage, not an exact support certificate.

adversarial_referee.rebuttal_or_downgrade: Require a schedule-uniform modulus theorem.

adversarial_referee.instance: The diameter is an opaque infimum.
adversarial_referee.rebuttal_or_downgrade: Require an explicit weighted path functional.
The envelope-induced sharpness is the nonroutine component.

seed_details.one_line: Polynomial forgetting changes the burn-in bias--variance frontier relative to geometric-mixing switchbacks without invoking a stochastic state model.

anchor_paper.author: Jia et al.
anchor_paper.claim: Truncated exposure-mapping Horvitz--Thompson estimation attains near-parametric rates under rapidly mixing hidden Markov interference.

seed_details.anti_pattern_check: M11: this is a rate frontier indexed by tail decay, not a relabelled mixing theorem.
seed_details.referee_objection: Polynomial mixing theory already has this calculation.
seed_details.rebuttal: The fixed potential-outcome envelope has no transition kernel, stationarity, or outcome noise from which conventional mixing bounds follow.

adversarial_referee.instance: The cited paper has the same GATE.
adversarial_referee.rebuttal_or_downgrade: Its law is hidden Markov and rapidly mixing, not a worst-case array.
The seed requires a minimax lower bound.
The focal object is the rate-optimal experimental cadence.

proposed_from.literature_map:
BojinovSimchiLeviZhao2023 formulate a single-unit fixed-potential-outcome minimax design problem and optimize cadence after fixing finite order \(m\).
Their order-learning procedure uses two separated experimental units, so it is not a one-path simultaneous-oracle result.
YuMaLiu2025 similarly puts a specified carryover order into a minimax design objective with spillovers.
HuWager2022 show that geometric forgetting determines burn-in geometry in a Markov system, but their randomness is not solely assignment randomization.
JiaKallusYu2023 obtain near-parametric GATE MSE through truncated exposures under rapid hidden-Markov mixing and spatial clustering.
GlynnJohariRasouli2020 establish the positive benchmark for outcome-adaptive design when data reveal reusable Markov transitions.
MissaultMasoero2025 detect underestimated finite influence periods by cross-lag comparison but do not localize a continuous infinite-tail exponent.
LiuZhong2026 obtain randomization tests under a known finite horizon, where conditional imputability remains available.
GoldenshlugerLepski2011 provides the pairwise-comparison mechanism for adaptive selection among scale-indexed estimators.
DuchiRuan2021 gives the general-loss constrained-risk inequality needed if the residual logarithmic adaptation penalty is lower bounded.
CaiLow2004 establishes the related principle that nested-class interval adaptation is governed by between-class distinguishability.
No located paper minimizes jointly over a fixed potential-outcome array and a decay index while allowing all sequential assignment kernels.

banked_proposal_promise_gap: The problem remains mathematically sound and promising, but the current solver could not prove the policy-uniform shifted/multiscale cadence dichotomy needed for a matching carryover-sensitive oracle lower bound.
